# Stock & Time Assistant (Google ADK + Ollama)

A multi-agent AI application built using Google ADK and LiteLLM with a local Ollama model.
The system includes:

- Time Agent: Provides the current system time
- Stock Price Agent: Fetches real-time stock prices using Yahoo Finance (yfinance)
- Local LLM: Runs fully offline using llama3.2 via Ollama
- Web UI: Interactive interface powered by adk web

# Tech Stack

- Python 3.10+
- Google ADK
- LiteLLM
- Ollama (Local LLM)
- llama3.2
- yfinance
- uv (Python package manager)

# Setup Instructions

1) Initialize the project

```bash
uv init
```

This will create:

- .venv/ virtual environment
- pyproject.toml

2) Install dependencies

```bash
uv add google-adk litellm ollama openai yfinance python-dotenv
```

3) Activate the virtual environment
On Windows:

```bash
.venv\Scripts\activate
```

On macOS / Linux:

```bash
source .venv/bin/activate
```

# Create the ADK App Structure

Run:

```bash
adk create app
```

You will be prompted with:

```bash
Choose model (1, 2):
1 --> Use Gemini
2 --> Don't use Gemini
```
Choose option 2 (Local LLM only)
This will generate

```ini
app/
 ├── agent.py
 ├── __init__.py

```

# Agent Implementation

Inside `app/agent.py`, define:

  - `current_time()` tool
  - `get_stock_price(ticker: str)` tool
  - `time_agent` (sub-agent)
  - `stock_price_agent` (root agent)

The system automatically routes:

  - Time questions → `time_agent`
  - Stock questions → `get_stock_price`

# Run the Application

Start the ADK Web UI:

```bash
adk web

```
